_help: World map window and channel bar in 1366x768 space. World map: wx,wy,ww,wh is the window; worldX/worldY the map art inside it; titleH is the title strip height; infoX/infoY the MAP INFO text; wcloseX/wcloseY the X button. Channel bar: chX,chY is the bar spot (the art is 436x67); chTextX/chTextY the world name; chCountX the channel count; chSlotX/chSlotY/chSlotPitch/chSlotW/chSlotH the channel ticks. The minimap window has its own file (panel-minimap.json).
